findings.title: Inbound MX routes @archestimator.com via Namecheap eforward, not Cloudflare Email Routing; topology inconsistent with outbound Worker Send Email
findings.resource: archestimator.com MX + SPF + Workers Send Email EMAIL binding

findings.expected_state: Either (a) MX + email() handler aligned for app-visible inbound, OR (b) documented operational split (outbound via Workers Send Email; inbound handled out-of-app via Namecheap)
findings.actual_state: Outbound from Worker softfails SPF (SPF authorizes Namecheap only); replies land in Namecheap; no app-visible bounce path
findings.release_consequence: Cohort notifications may softfail recipient SPF checks; bounces invisible to app

findings.existing_pack_disposition: NEW_OWNER_HERE (Infosec UNIT-004 owns CRLF/HTML injection chokepoint, not mail topology)
findings.smallest_remediation_direction: Document the operational split explicitly; either add Cloudflare Email Routing + email() handler, OR add SPF include for Cloudflare Workers Send Email + DMARC alignment + DKIM; cohort comms doc clarifies the reply path
findings.hosted_verification_needed_after_remedia: Recipient-side email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) passes for a Worker-sent test message
findings.authorization_boundary: Operator DNS changes (DNS boundary — outside wrangler.jsonc)

findings.second_pass_challenge: Challenger noted Workers Send Email uses an account-verified address — but verified-address mechanism is for outbound From, not for SPF/DKIM alignment of the archestimator.com domain

findings.expected_state: DMARC p=quarantine or reject with monitoring; DKIM published for the outbound signing selector; SPF includes all authorized senders
findings.actual_state: DMARC monitor-only; DKIM absent; SPF narrow
findings.release_consequence: Cohort emails may be marked spam or softfail SPF

findings.smallest_remediation_direction: Publish DKIM; align SPF; move DMARC to p=quarantine after monitoring
